items.question: What makes a Cycle Science experience different from a regular MTB trip?
items.answer: We combine guided mountain biking with safari-style landscapes, curated accommodation, meals, and destination immersion. It is a full safari experience on two wheels — not just trail access.

items.question: What is the difference between Local Rider and International Guest rates?
items.answer: Local Rider Rates in ZAR are designed to offer South African mountain bikers outstanding value. International Guest Rates position the same premium product for overseas travellers in a globally understood format. Both tiers are always visible so you can see the offer that applies to you.

items.question: Do I need to be an expert rider?
items.answer: Our launch packages are aimed at intermediate and intermediate+ riders comfortable on varied terrain. Contact us to discuss fitness, bike setup, and the right destination for your level.

items.question: What is included in the package price?
items.answer: Each package lists inclusions such as guiding, accommodation, meals, and trail fees. Exclusions and optional upgrades (e.g. 4x4 transport) are shown on destination pages. Confirm final inclusions when you enquire.

items.question: Can you arrange private or corporate groups?
items.answer: Yes. We are building capacity for private group and corporate trips. Enquire with your dates, group size, and preferred destination.

items.question: How do I book?
items.answer: Use the Enquire form or contact us via email or WhatsApp. We will confirm availability, pricing, and itinerary details before you commit.

items.question: Will more destinations be added?
items.answer: Yes. The site is built to add new KwaZulu-Natal and beyond destinations as Cycle Science expands — Zingela, Drakensberg, and Karkloof are our launch locations.
